decision_requested: Clarify executable folder rename/membership path without widening public api ifMatch.
accepted: ADR-0129 (3) A1 directs tree rename and membership through batch/cas rather than folder PUT/If-Match.

source_findings.text: POST /console/batch permits only fields.members; name and parent are explicitly not written by the batch door.
The closed own-call list names POST /folders, PUT/DELETE /folders/<id>, but not POST /console/batch.
Public opts.ifMatch remains a unit revision and the approved closed path list must not widen.

recommendation: Keep the public api/ifMatch contract closed. Either approve the exact related P06 batch-name form/rights/schema binding and P07 own-call-list delta, or correct A1 to an internal folder request with existing quoted-index If-Match (not public api.opts.ifMatch). No active choice has been made here.
limits: No P06 form or judge change; no new command/port/class/alias.
A2-A5 can be delivered independently; A1 is not claimed closed.
